From: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>

Subject: Last-mile check — final stage signals & evidence

Team —

Quick, actionable reminder for the final submission window: please update your SFDC stage to reflect the signal you can commit to by EOD Friday and attach the corresponding piece of evidence in the template I attached. This helps Finance lock the number without follow-ups.

What I need from each owner by Friday 5pm PT:
- Final committed ARR (rounded to nearest $1k) and SFDC stage
- One-line reason if the deal is still risky (customer approval, PO, procurement, legal)
- Evidence file or link (MOPR, signed LOE, email thread) uploaded to Drive and the template filled: Q3_stage_signals_template.xlsx

Call: I’ll run a short 20-min stand-by call on Monday 10/12 at 10:00am PT to confirm anything that changed after submission. If you have an account you want me to run on the call, mark it as "Discuss on 10/12" in the template.

Agenda for the Monday call (20m):
- Rollup of final net ARR and outflows (5m)
- Quick triage of top 3 risky deals flagged (10m)
- Confirm any required escalations to PS/Sales leadership (5m)

I’ve attached the template to make this easy. If you absolutely can’t meet the Friday window, ping me with a time you can provide the evidence.

Thanks,
Marissa
Marissa Cole
Director, Revenue Operations
Redwood Inference
attachments: Q3_stage_signals_template.xlsx (spreadsheet)
